headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds fell to the Washington Nationals 7-1, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. In other action, the Oakland Athletics edged the Boston Red Sox 4-3, while the New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1. The Philadelphia Phillies secured a narrow victory over the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6, and the Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Cooper Pratt of the Milwaukee Brewers, Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, Cole Wilcox of the Seattle Mariners, Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, and Chris Murphy of the Chicago White Sox.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. In other roster movement, the Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, while the Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Brad Lord pitched 2.2 innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates in a lopsided 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, throwing 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 7-6 Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a narrow victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, winning 7-6 in a closely contested game. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that brings new depth to the team's roster.
